name: Zverinoe Serdce
source:
Since you were a little girl, you dreamed of having a pet, but your father's allergies made it impossible. When you left your parents' home, you finally realized your long-held wish. 

But what if your new pets are not quite what they seem? How will you care for them in that case? Will you be able to accept their true nature and love them no matter what? 

[From [url=https://getfesj.itch.io/animalheart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你还是个小女孩的时候，你就梦想拥有一只宠物，但你父亲的过敏症让你梦想成真。当你离开父母的家时，你终于实现了自己的夙愿。

但是，如果你的新宠物与看上去不太一样怎么办？在这种情况下，你将如何照顾他们？你能接受他们的真实本性并无论如何爱他们吗？

[来自[url=https://getfesj.itch.io/animalheart]itch.io[/url]]
